fullPassage: Countershading is the process of optical flattening that provides camouflage to animals. When sunlight illuminates an object from above, the object will be brightest on top. The color of the object will gradually shade darker toward the bottom. This shading gives the object depth and allows the viewer to distinguish its shape. Thus even if an animal is exactly, but uniformly, the same color as the substrate, it will be easily visible when illuminated. Most animals, however, are darker above than they are below. When they are illuminated from above, the darker back is lightened and the lighter belly is shaded. The animal thus appears to be a single color and easily blends in with the substrate. This pattern of coloration, or countershading, reinforces the visual impression of shape in the organism. It allows the animal to blend in with its background.

When sunlight illuminates an object from above, the object will be brightest on top. The color of the object will gradually shade darker toward the bottom. When they are illuminated from above, the darker back is lightened and the lighter belly is shaded. The animal thus appears to be a single color and easily blends in with the substrate. det.analysis:

❌ ② exposure(노출): camouflage(위장)의 반의어로 문맥 불일치
❌ ③ ignore(무시하다): distinguish(구별하다)의 반의어로 문맥 불일치
❌ ④ elimination(제거): coloration(채색)과 전혀 다른 의미
det.tip: camouflage(위장) ↔ exposure(노출), distinguish(구별하다) ↔ ignore(무시하다), coloration(채색 패턴) ↔ elimination(제거)

❌ ② sensation(감각): impression과 유사한 감각 영역
❌ ④ appearance(외관/보이는 것): impression의 동의어에 가까움
det.tip: impression(인상/착각) ↔ reality(실제). 역음영이 만드는 '착각'(impression)은 실제(reality)와 다름

questions.passage:
(A) This shading gives the object depth and allows the viewer to <u>distinguish</u> its shape.

(B) It is important to <u>distinguish</u> between facts and opinions when reading news articles.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 distinguish의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) distinguish = 식별하다(지각으로 인식), (B) distinguish = 구별하다(차이를 판단)
det.analysis:
✅ ② (A) 식별하다 — (B) 구별하다: (A)는 음영이 주는 입체감으로 형태를 '시각적으로 식별'하는 것, (B)는 사실과 의견의 '차이를 구별/판단'하는 것으로 미묘하게 다른 의미 ←정답
❌ ① (A) 구별하다 — (B) 탁월하게 하다: (B)의 distinguish oneself(두각을 나타내다)와 혼동. 본문 맥락과 불일치
❌ ③ (A) 묘사하다 — (B) 구별하다: (A) distinguish는 묘사가 아니라 지각/식별
❌ ④ (A) 식별하다 — (B) 묘사하다: (B) distinguish는 묘사가 아니라 구별
det.tip: distinguish: ① 식별하다(지각) ② 구별하다(판단) ③ 두각을 나타내다(distinguish oneself). 문맥으로 구분

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

the way that an animal or plant is colored and patterned, especially to blend in with its surroundings

det.analysis:
✅ ① coloration: '동물이나 식물의 색깔과 무늬 방식, 특히 주변 환경에 섞이기 위한 것' = coloration(채색/색깔 패턴) ←정답
❌ ② illumination(조명/빛): 빛을 비추는 것이지 채색 패턴이 아님
❌ ③ organism(유기체/생물): 생물 전체를 가리키는 말
❌ ④ substrate(배경 물질): 동물이 섞여드는 환경이지 채색 패턴이 아님
det.tip: coloration: color + -ation(명사화). 동물의 색깔 배열 패턴. countershading = a type of coloration

questions.passage: Countershading is the process of optical flattening that provides camouflage to animals. When sunlight __________ (illuminate) an object from above, the object will be brightest on top.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: illuminate → illuminates: 주어가 sunlight(3인칭 단수)이고 현재 시제이므로 동사에 -s를 붙임. '햇빛이 물체를 위에서 비춘다'
det.tip: 3인칭 단수 현재: he/she/it + 동사-(e)s. sunlight = it → illuminates

overlay.excerptSentences: Countershading is the process of optical flattening that provides camouflage to animals. When sunlight __________ (illuminate) an object from above, the object will be brightest on top.

questions.passage: This pattern of coloration, or countershading, __________ (reinforcement) the visual impression of shape in the organism.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: reinforcement(명사) → reinforces(동사): 주어 'This pattern of coloration'(3인칭 단수)에 맞는 현재 시제 동사. 명사→동사 파생형: reinforcement(명사) → reinforce(동사) → reinforces(3단현)
det.tip: reinforce(동사) + -ment → reinforcement(명사). 역방향: reinforcement → reinforce → reinforces

overlay.excerptSentences: This pattern of coloration, or countershading, __________ (reinforcement) the visual impression of shape in the organism.

questions.passage: Countershading is the process of optical flattening that provides camouflage to animals. When sunlight illuminates an object from above, the object will be brightest on top. The color of the object will gradually shade darker toward the bottom. This shading gives the object depth and allows the viewer to distinguish its shape. Thus even if an animal is exactly, but uniformly, the same color as the substrate, it will be easily visible when illuminated. Most animals, however, are darker above than they are below. When they are illuminated from above, the darker back is lightened and the lighter belly is shaded. The animal thus appears to be a single color and easily blends in with the substrate. This pattern of coloration, or countershading, reinforces the visual impression of shape in the organism. It allows the animal to blend in with its __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ background: 원문 일치. 역음영이 동물로 하여금 '배경/주변 환경'에 섞여들게 한다는 마무리 문장 ←정답
❌ ① predator(포식자): 포식자 속에 섞이는 것이 아니라 배경에 섞이는 것
❌ ② shadow(그림자): 그림자 속에 섞이는 것이 아니라 배경 환경에 섞이는 것
❌ ③ territory(영역): 영역에 섞인다는 표현은 문맥상 어색함
det.tip: blend in with its background = 배경에 섞여들다. 역음영의 최종 목적 = 배경과의 동화

questions.passage: Countershading is the process of optical __________ that provides camouflage to animals. When sunlight illuminates an object from above, the object will be brightest on top. The color of the object will gradually shade darker toward the bottom. This shading gives the object depth and allows the viewer to distinguish its shape. Thus even if an animal is exactly, but uniformly, the same color as the substrate, it will be easily visible when illuminated. Most animals, however, are darker above than they are below. When they are illuminated from above, the darker back is lightened and the lighter belly is shaded. The animal thus appears to be a single color and easily blends in with the substrate. This pattern of coloration, or countershading, reinforces the visual impression of shape in the organism. It allows the animal to blend in with its background.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ flattening: 원문 일치. 역음영은 '광학적 평탄화(optical flattening)' 과정. 빛과 그늘이 만드는 입체감을 역전시켜 형태를 평평하게 보이게 함 ←정답
❌ ① sharpening(날카롭게 함/선명화): 형태를 더 뚜렷하게 하는 것이지 위장의 원리와 반대 방향
❌ ② magnification(확대): 크기를 키우는 것으로 위장과 무관
❌ ④ reflection(반사): 빛의 반사이지, 형태를 평탄화하는 과정과 다름
det.tip: optical flattening(광학적 평탄화): 빛과 그늘을 이용해 입체감을 제거하여 형태를 배경에 섞이게 하는 과정
